name: 17740 · Jersey Shore, PA
findings: ZIP 17740 (Jersey Shore) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17740 (Jersey Shore) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
